title: Briefing the Institute of Noetic Sciences board

tellings.quote: Like I astronaut Ed Edgar Mitchell invited me to uh brief the board of knowetic sciences back years ago.

plain: Steven Greer, a man who says he has briefed many officials about UFOs, says that years ago, probably in the 1990s, astronaut Edgar Mitchell invited him to brief the board of the Institute of Noetic Sciences, a group that studies the mind and consciousness. He tells it to show that serious, well-known figures were interested in what he had to say.
